project.name: AI Review Evaluation Fixture
project.description: A community tool library: members borrow tools, reserve them, return them, and volunteers repair them.

actor.text: Dana Whitfield is the library's treasurer.
actor.name: Dana Whitfield

actor.text: Anyone who is not library staff.
actor.name: Non-staff

actor.text: A library employee who runs the desk and looks after the tool stock.
actor.name: Staff

actor.text: A person with a current library membership, who may borrow tools.
actor.name: Member

step.name: The member brings the tool to the desk
A member submits a purchase request
The member opens the loan on the account page
The system adds 7 days to the loan's due date and shows the new date
The system or staff mark the tool as broken
Staff photograph the damage and email the member
Staff put the tool on the repair shelf

scenario.name: Check out at the desk

scenario.name: Approve a purchase request

scenario.name: Renew from the account page

term.text: A loan is when a tool is loaned.
term.name: Loan

term.text: An overdue tool is a tool that is overdue.
term.name: Overdue tool

term.text: The day, chosen when a member reserves a tool, on which the member may collect it from the desk.
term.name: Pickup date

goal.text: Members should really enjoy using the tool library.
goal.name: Members love the library

goal.text: The system sends a text message to every member who has an overdue tool.
goal.name: Send overdue reminders by text message

goal.text: Fewer than five members a month complain about overdue reminders.
goal.name: Fewer complaints about reminders

goal.text: Dana Whitfield approves every new tool purchase over 200 dollars.
goal.name: Dana approves tool purchases

goal.text: A member can find any tool in the catalogue within one minute.
goal.name: Members find tools quickly

goal.text: A member can search the tool catalogue by tool name and see the shelf where the tool is kept.
goal.name: Members search the catalogue by name

goal.text: Members with a suspended account, or with more than two overdue tools, may not borrow tools.
goal.name: Suspended members cannot borrow

goal.text: Members can reserve tools online, and the library launches a mobile app for members.
goal.name: Online reservations and a mobile app

goal.text: Member contact details are never shared with anyone outside the library staff, at any time.
goal.name: Member data stays private

goal.text: The volunteer team holds a stand-up every Monday to plan the week's repairs.
goal.name: Volunteers plan repairs weekly

goal.text: The checkout desk scans the barcode on the tool. Every tool already carries exactly one barcode label.
goal.name: Barcode scanning at checkout

goal.text: The library will track the on-time return rate of borrowed tools each month.
goal.name: Tools come back on time

goal.text: All alerts raised by the tool-condition monitor, which this project builds, are acknowledged by staff within one working day.
goal.name: Condition alerts are acknowledged

goal.text: A signed-in member can see every tool they currently have on loan and the date each one is due back.
goal.name: Members see what they have on loan

story.text: As a member, I want to borrow a cordless drill.
story.name: Borrow a drill

story.text: As a member, I want to reserve a tool and pay my annual fee online so that I save a trip to the library.
story.name: Reserve and pay online

story.text: When a member returns a tool late: 1. staff scan the tool; 2. the system works out the fine; 3. staff take the payment; 4. the receipt prints.
story.name: Late returns

story.text: Last quarter the repair desk logged 32 broken tools (24 power tools and 8 hand tools). As a repair volunteer, I want broken tools triaged at the counter so that the backlog halves to 16 by the end of next quarter.
story.name: Halve the repair backlog

story.text: As a member, I want to drop a borrowed tool in the after-hours return box so that I can return it when the library is closed.
story.name: Return a tool after hours

usecase.text: A member checks out a tool.
usecase.name: Check out a tool

usecase.text: Dana reviews the purchase request and approves it.
usecase.name: Approve a purchase

usecase.text: A member renews one of their current loans so that it is due back 7 days after its current due date. Preconditions: the member is signed in and has no overdue tools, the loan is not past its due date, and no other member has reserved the tool.
usecase.name: Renew a loan
